name: zdi_set_variant_tag_if_unset
description: zDi::SetVariantTagIfUnset fills unset DI entry variant tags with the supplied byte tag while preserving entries that already have an initialized variant tag.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zDi/zModel material source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x476340 validates the fastcall zDi pointer/tag arguments, null and nonpositive-entry no-op paths, entry cursor at variantTagInitialized/variantTag, preserving already-initialized entries, and setting initialized/tag bytes for unset entries.
The native zClass predicate helper smoke verifies unset entries receive the requested tag, an initialized entry is preserved, and null zDi input is accepted as a no-op.
